title: 写作与表达：中文写作的隐疾 — Day 19
title_en: Writing & Expression: The Hidden Ailments of Chinese Prose — Day 19

questions.question: 按「可证伪测试」，如何判断周报里的「我们将持续提升用户体验、狠抓落实」？
options: 反面没人会主张，等于没说，应改写成谁、做什么、何时完成、怎么验证
它只要补上「高度重视」等更有力的修饰，读者就会感到团队的决心
它的问题在于不够凝练，换成「兹、特此」一类文言词收紧句子就能解决
它态度积极、措辞得体，在组织环境里属于安全的写法，只要不出现翻译腔就可以保留
questions.explanation: 可证伪测试是把一句话反过来说：没人会主张「降低用户体验、敷衍了事」，原句就等于没说，需要换成具体动作。以为套话「安全」是文中点名的误区，「兹、特此」这类假文言也只是另一种八股。
questions.question_en: Applying the 'falsifiability test', how should you judge a status-report line like 'We will keep improving user experience and drive execution hard'?
options_en: Nobody would argue for its opposite, so it carries no information; rewrite it as who does what, by when, and how it will be checked
It just needs stronger modifiers like 'highly prioritize' so readers sense the team's resolve
Its problem is a lack of concision; tightening it with faux-classical formulas would fix it
It is positive and appropriately worded, a safe choice in an organization, and fine to keep as long as there's no translationese
questions.explanation_en: The test is to flip the sentence: no one would advocate 'worsen user experience and slack off', so the original says nothing and should become concrete actions. Treating boilerplate as 'safe' is a misconception the piece names, and faux-classical formulas are just another kind of boilerplate.

questions.question: 「我们对该方案进行了讨论，并对其细节作出了优化」，按「万能动词」原则应怎样修改？
options: 删掉句中所有的「的」和「对」，改成「我们进行讨论方案，作出优化细节」
换一个更精确、更正式的搭配动词：「我们对该方案开展了深入讨论，并对其细节实施了优化」
保留原句，因为「进行」「作出」让表达显得正式专业，适合书面汇报
把被压成名词的动作还原成动词、删掉空壳动词：「我们讨论了这个方案，并优化了细节」
questions.explanation: 「进行、作出」是空洞的万能动词，真正的动作被埋进名词「讨论」「优化」里，即 Helen Sword 说的僵尸名词；修法只有一步：名词变回动词，删掉空壳。换成「开展、实施」只是换了个空壳，以为「进行」显得专业是文中点名的误区。
questions.question_en: How should 'We conducted a discussion of the plan and made optimizations to its details' be revised under the 'empty verbs' principle?
options_en: Strip out every particle and preposition so it reads 'We conducted discuss plan, made optimize details'
Swap in more precise support verbs: 'We carried out a discussion of the plan and implemented optimizations to its details'
Keep it, since 'conduct' and 'make' sound formal and professional, right for a written report
Turn the buried nouns back into verbs and drop the empty verbs: 'We discussed the plan and optimized the details'
questions.explanation_en: Empty verbs like 'conduct' and 'make' (in Chinese, jinxing and zuochu) carry no meaning; the real actions are buried in the nouns 'discussion' and 'optimization' — Helen Sword's zombie nouns. The fix is one step: restore the verb and delete the shell. Swapping in 'carry out' or 'implement' just changes the shell, and thinking such verbs sound professional is a misconception the piece calls out.

questions.question: 「文白相济」主张向文言借什么、不借什么？
options: 借文言的正式感，用「兹、特此、谨、望周知」这类词，让通知显得庄重而又凝练有分量
借文言的典故与生僻字，越密集越能体现作者的修养和文字功力
借文言的凝练与节奏，比如在最需要回味处用一个四字格，不借它的腔调和公文式虚饰
什么都不借，现代白话应当彻底摆脱文言，越接近口语大白话越好
questions.explanation: 文白相济是用文言的简洁、音节为现代意思服务，借筋骨不借行头。「兹、特此」这类假文言被明确称为另一种八股，堆典故掉书袋是另一误区；文中也说白话不必是大白话。
questions.question_en: What does 'blending classical and vernacular' say to borrow from classical Chinese, and what not to borrow?
options_en: Borrow its formality, using stock formulas like 'hereby' and 'be it known' to make a notice sound solemn and compact
Borrow its allusions and rare characters; the denser they are, the more cultivated the writer appears
Borrow its concision and rhythm, such as a four-character phrase where resonance matters most, but not its airs or bureaucratic ornament
Borrow nothing: modern vernacular should break with classical Chinese entirely and be as colloquial as possible
questions.explanation_en: The idea is to let classical concision and cadence serve modern meaning — borrowing the bones, not the costume. Faux-classical formulas like 'hereby notify' are explicitly called another kind of boilerplate, piling on allusions is another trap, and the piece says vernacular need not be flat colloquial speech.
